_instructions: Setting descriptors for the configuration composer (see crates/modules/configuration/settings-catalog.json). Current values are always read live; descriptors hold no defaults.

settings.description: Text size of chat message bubbles, in pixels.
Mode a new chat starts in: ask (asks before acting), plan (read-only planning) or auto (acts without asking where policy allows).
examples: new chats should start in ask mode

settings.description: Ask for confirmation when someone switches a chat to Auto mode.
examples: warn me before switching to auto
don't ask when I pick auto

settings.description: Largest file, in megabytes, that can be attached to a chat message.
How many files one chat message may attach.
How often, in milliseconds, an open chat checks for new messages.
examples: check for new messages more often

settings.description: Hint text shown in the empty message box.
examples: change the message box hint to 'Ask me anything'
placeholder text should say Type here

settings.description: Mark a chat as read as soon as it is opened.
examples: mark chats read when I open them
keep the unread badge until I scroll

settings.description: Show the Main Notes panel below the chat header in Main Chat.
On phones, how many earlier messages stay loaded above the visible part of a chat.
examples: keep 50 earlier messages on the phone

settings.description: Width, in pixels, of the floating chat widget window.
Which side of the screen the floating chat launcher button sits on.
examples: move the chat button to the left
